dataset: TCM pattern family (辨證體系) controlled vocabulary
policy: Controlled vocabulary for pattern.* records' `pattern_family` — the 辨證體系 a pattern belongs to. Enforced by scripts/validate-pattern-standard.js P1.

Built from what pattern_registry already uses (its `system`/`system_zh` fields, 50/61 records) plus the classical systems the template names, so no existing record has to be re-labelled to fit a newly invented scheme.

One pattern, one family. A pattern that genuinely sits in two systems (痰熱壅肺 is both 臟腑 and 病因) takes the system its DIAGNOSIS is made in — the one whose questions you ask to reach it — and records the other in `secondary_family`.
IDs are ASCII (D10). Do not add a family without adding it here first: an unlisted value is a P1 defect, which is the point.
note: The registry's 11 unlabelled records (衝任不調, 寒凝肝脈, 下焦濕熱, 脾胃濕熱, 飲食積滯, 熱痺, 痰濕阻肺, 痰熱壅肺, 痰迷心竅, 風寒犯肺, 風熱犯肺) are the fill line's first batch — each needs a family assigned from this list, not invented.

records.scope_zh: 表裡・寒熱・虛實・陰陽。所有辨證的底層座標,通常與其他體系並用而非單獨成證。
定位到臟腑的證型(肝氣鬱結・脾氣虛・腎陽虛)。本庫最大宗。
氣虛・氣滯・血虛・血瘀・痰飲・津液虧損等,不以臟腑為主軸者。
六淫・七情・飲食勞倦所致(外風・寒濕・飲食積滯)。
傷寒論體系:太陽・陽明・少陽・太陰・少陰・厥陰。本庫尚未使用,方證多屬此系。
溫病體系:衛分・氣分・營分・血分。本庫尚未使用。
溫病體系:上焦・中焦・下焦。本庫尚未使用。
以經絡循行定位(足太陽經證・經筋病)。針灸科最常用,本庫尚未使用。
